feedback: Accepted. (1) Format and header: the artifact follows the paper schema exactly (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION); FINAL_STATES is present and nonempty, u3 is declared, and it is accepting for the task since every transition into u3 is guarded by at_exit, so u3 encodes exactly the mandatory clause 'reach the exit'. (2) Completeness/ordered coverage: within each state the explicit guards are mutually exclusive and the trailing else makes the transition function total; u0 and u1 partition all four (at_exit, holding_box) combinations, u2 splits on at_exit only, and u3 is absorbing. (3) Irrelevant events: siren_ringing, switch_toggled and box_fell appear in no guard, and every state's else self-loop absorbs them at zero reward, so a ringing siren, a toggle, or a box fall neither distracts the machine nor pays anything — correct, since this task constrains neither the siren nor drops. (4) Semantic fidelity of the bonus: with no movement predicate among the five propositions, 'carry the box on two different moves' is best formalized as holding_box true on two distinct steps, which is what the monotone counter u0->u1->u2 (+0.1, +0.2) implements; any agent that genuinely carries on two moves necessarily holds on at least two steps and reaches the full 1.3 (0.1+0.2+1.0), exit-only play earns 1.0, and a one-step partial carry earns 1.1, so the preference ordering matches the task's structure (exit mandatory, carry optional 'if you can'). The folded exit rewards are internally consistent (1.1/1.2 = 1.0 + the holding-step bonus when the exit step itself is a holding step), and from u2 exiting with or without the box pays the same 1.0, correctly not requiring the box at the exit and not double-counting. (5) Reward safety: progress rewards fire once each, no transition ever goes backward (appropriate — 'carried on two moves' is a monotone achievement, so no regressions are required), u3 is absorbing, and the maximum episode return is bounded at 1.3 with no farmable cycle; the 0.1/0.2 progress rewards are dense but strictly bounded. (6) Setup robustness: in box-less setups holding_box is never true, the machine stays in u0 and pays a clean 1.0 at the exit, matching the 'if you can' caveat. Minor caveats, not grounds for rejection: the step-count proxy over-approximates — an agent could earn the full 0.3 by holding across two non-move steps (e.g., turning in place), a distinction the proposition set cannot express; the exit-with-box transitions out of u0/u1 (1.1/1.2) are practically unreachable given the box-to-exit distance but serve as harmless, consistently folded defensive completions; zero-reward else entries are rightly omitted under the default-0 reward convention.
